properties.statement: [BL-164] The schema's own size is hand-copied into at least NINE places, and adding one node type broke the build four separate times
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Found 2026-08-02 while building [BL-68], by counting the fix cycles: one schema addition (ReadinessAssessment + two edge types) produced four independent red builds, each in a different layer, each the same one-line edit.* The merged schema knows it has 29 node types and 60 edge types. Nine other places also claim to know, by hand: schema.rs's test, vocabulary.rs's test, reflow2-mcp/tests/tools.rs's test, tools/smoke_mcp.py's schema-discovery check, and prose in schema.rs, lib.rs, AGENTS.md (twice), README.md, docs/overview.md and docs/interaction-surfaces.md. THE PROSE HALF WAS ALREADY WRONG BEFORE THIS CHANGE TOUCHED IT, which is the actual finding: schema.rs's own doc comment said *53 edge types* while the test three screens below asserted 58; lib.rs said *27 node types, 53 edge types*; AGENTS.md, README.md and overview.md all said *57*; interaction-surfaces.md said *55*. Five documents disagreeing with the code and with each other, and nothing noticed \u2014 because only the four TEST copies are enforced, and a test copy is exactly the one a builder updates without thinking. This is [BL-159]'s class for the third time and [BL-152]'s for the fourth \u2014 two records of one contract, kept by hand, drifting \u2014 and the pattern is now well enough evidenced to state plainly: *in this repo, a hand-copied fact about the code is not a fact, it is a decaying claim.* Fix shape, and it is small because the machinery exists: skill_lint.py already cross-checks AGENTS.md's gate block against ci.yml four ways, so teach it one more check \u2014 the counts asserted in prose must equal what validate_schema.py computes from schema/*.yaml, which already prints them. The TEST copies are a separate and easier call: they could read the count from load_schema() instead of restating it, though there is an argument that a test restating the number is the point (it fails when the vocabulary moves, which is a deliberate speed bump on a stamp-moving change). So the recommendation splits: make the four test copies stay hand-written and LOUD, and make the five prose copies computed or linted, because prose has no such speed bump \u2014 it simply rots. Size S", "origin": "Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-164 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: S."}
